Generated code compilation/loading error:
cuModuleLoadDataEx failed: CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_PTX: a PTX JIT compilation failed
PTX JIT error log:
ptxas application ptx input, line 46; fatal   : Parsing error near 'f': syntax error
ptxas fatal   : Ptx assembly aborted due to errors
Loading ModelNew failed: ModelNew is None
fix:
<reasoning>
The PTX JIT parse error stems from using C-style float literal suffixes ('f') in the PTX source. PTX does not accept the trailing 'f' on floating-point immediates. Removing the 'f' suffix from the four mov.f32 instructions fixes the compilation while preserving the kernel’s logic and the Python glue code unchanged.
</reasoning>
```json
[
  {
    "action": "replace",
    "line_number": 50,
    "new_code": "    mov.f32 %f3, 0.044715;"
  },
  {
    "action": "replace",
    "line_number": 54,
    "new_code": "    mov.f32 %f5, 0.7978845834732056; // sqrt(2/pi)"
  },
  {
    "action": "replace",
    "line_number": 61,
    "new_code": "    mov.f32 %f8, 1.0;"
  },
  {
    "action": "replace",
    "line_number": 63,
    "new_code": "    mov.f32 %f10, 0.5;"
  }
]
```
